_comment: Copy to config.json beside server.js (or point CONFIG_FILE at it). The admin page at /admin edits the same file, and adds the users. Keys starting with _ are ignored. The server writes this file itself, so a hand edit is best made while it is stopped.
name: Dev review server
_storage: The read-only share that holds the review media, and the Windows account DJV maps it with. The account's password is not here: it is read from SHARE_PASSWORD_FILE.
_djvVersion: The DJV version every PC should run. A PC running another version is warned. Empty to not check.
_users: Added on the admin page, with their passwords hashed. The administrator, lldjv, is made from ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE when the server starts.
